text:
I don't know. Attendance figures for 1890s games like this are rarely recorded precisely, and I can't give an exact number without fabricating one. I also can't reliably confirm the date of the first meeting (it was in the early 1890s, but I'm not certain of the year).

Syracuse's football media guide archives and the Colgate/Syracuse yearly game records, or contemporary newspaper coverage (for example the Syracuse Post-Standard via Fultonhistory.com or NYS Historic Newspapers), are the places most likely to have it, if it was recorded at all.
